Set properties of an entity

synSetProperties.Rd

Set one or more properties of a Synapse entity object, such as its name, description, version_label, activity, or annotations, and return the entity so it can be piped into synStore().

The changes are only made to the local entity object; call synStore() to save them to Synapse.

Each argument must be named, and every name must be an attribute of the entity's model class (for example a field of File or Folder); otherwise an error is raised listing the names that are not valid. When duplicate properties are provided, the first one will be used. Calling synSetProperties() with no properties returns the entity unchanged.

Setting annotations replaces all of the entity's annotations. To add to the existing annotations, combine them first, e.g. annotations = append(entity$annotations, list(key = "value")); to remove all annotations, set annotations = list().

Usage

synSetProperties(entity, ...)

Arguments

entity

A Synapse entity object, for example one created with File(), Folder() or Project(), or returned by synGet().

...

Named properties to set, e.g. name = "new name" or annotations = list(key = "value").

Value

The entity with the properties set.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
synSetProperties(entity, annotations = list(key = "value"))
synSetProperties(entity, name = "new name", annotations = list(key = "value", key2 = "value2"))
} # }
